prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1350; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a side-impact motor vehicle collision at an intersection with complaints of right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion. Initial examination revealed effusion and tenderness along the medial joint line, with pain on valgus stress testing. Imaging was obtained to rule out fracture, and findings were consistent with a medial collateral ligament sprain with associated soft tissue contusion, without evidence of bony injury.

Conservative management was pursued, including rest, activity modification, ice, compression, and a hinged knee brace for protection during the early recovery phase. The patient completed a structured physical therapy program focused on restoring range of motion, quadriceps and hamstring strengthening, gait normalization, and progressive return to functional activities. Over the course of 22 visits, the patient demonstrated steady improvement in pain levels, joint swelling, and strength, with full range of motion regained by the final evaluation.

At discharge, the patient was ambulating without assistance and reported minimal residual discomfort with prolonged standing. Continued home exercise was recommended, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
